mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 1.0% compresses the risk-free rate, reducing equity discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS below 1.0% for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.1 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending power and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE increase > 0.1pp in 1 month but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) from prior month indicate broad consumer demand contraction, reducing corporate revenue expectations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST and RSAFS both decline from prior month but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO below 100) signals manufacturing sector weakness, reducing corporate capital expenditure and economic growth expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO below 100 but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST above 1200) indicates strong consumer confidence and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as the market anticipates near-term growth momentum.
failure_condition: HOUST above 1200 for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI increase exceeding 0.5% signals accelerating inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten policy, which compresses equity valuations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL increase > 0.5% from prior month but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE > 4.5%) combined with restrictive monetary policy (FEDFUNDS > 1.0%) signals labor market stress amid tight policy, reducing corporate hiring and growth expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: labor market stress with restrictive policy
failure_condition: UNRATE > 4.5% and FEDFUNDS > 1.0% but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: Slowing GDP growth (GDPC1 quarterly growth rate below 1.0% annualized) indicates economic deceleration, reducing corporate earnings forecasts and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the market prices in recession risks.
failure_condition: GDPC1 quarterly growth rate < 1.0% annualized but S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such periods.
